Since the API's rate limit moved to quotas.Limiter(5, "1m"), a client that
makes five quick requests stays locked out. Five requests from "acme" at
t = 0, 1, 2, 3 and 4 seconds, then a sixth at t = 130 seconds, more than two
minutes later: the sixth is refused with QuotaExceededError ("client 'acme'
made 5 requests in the last 1m"). It should be admitted, the window is one
minute.
